r19d-001.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning. | whereas

item.q: Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning.
item.why: All three words show a contrast, but only *whereas* (or *while*) joins two facts with a comma in the middle: *…, whereas I'm at my best early.* *however* and *nevertheless* start a new sentence or come after a semicolon: *…late nights; however, I'm…*
item.why_lv: Visi trīs vārdi izsaka pretstatu, bet tikai *whereas* (vai *while*) ar komatu teikuma vidū savieno divus faktus: *…, whereas I'm at my best early.* *however* un *nevertheless* sāk jaunu teikumu vai stāv aiz semikola: *…late nights; however, I'm…*
